author: juicy
description: Bring your colonists to life with RimTalk! This revolutionary mod uses Google's AI to generate dynamic, context-aware dialogue for your pawns in real-time. If the mod settings allow for more than 3 traits per pawn, children will have more frequent growth moments to enable them to attain that many traits. With Anomaly: there are two new benefits and two new downsides available to 'creepy joiners', each involving a unique trait. description: This mod does not add any extra furniture to the game. It just tries to make the vanilla outfit stands a little bit easier to use. Vanilla outfit stands will only "swap" your clothes, which means it's very complex if you want to put all your clothes to an empty stand. I think it's easier to prepare two suites of clothes for your colonists than to put your clothes to an empty outfit stand. This mod will pop up a window when you right-click it and choose "Better Outfit Stand". This window shows two columns on one page: "Put on stand" and "Wear from stand". In "Put on stand", choose clothes worn by the colonist to move onto the stand. In "Wear from stand", choose clothes from the stand to wear; conflicting worn clothes are moved to the stand. This mod also adds a "Put on target outfit stand" command to spawned apparel and weapons. When a colony outfit stand exists, click the command and then click the target stand to order a colonist to haul the item there. The target stand automatically allows that item. Automatic filter disallowing when an item is removed is temporarily paused, so taking an item off the stand will not change that def's filter setting. 本模组并不添加任何额外的家具。它只是尝试让原版的服装架更容易使用。 原版的服装架只能“交换”衣服，这意味着如果你想把所有的衣服放到架子上会非常复杂。 我认为为殖民者准备两套衣服比把衣服放到空的服装架上更容易。 本模组在你右键点击服装架并选择“更方便的服装架”时会弹出一个窗口。这个窗口在同一页左右两栏显示：“放到衣架上”和“从衣架上穿”。 在“放到衣架上”里，选择殖民者身上要放到架子上的衣服。在“从衣架上穿”里，选择要从架子上穿上的衣服；冲突的已穿服装会自动换到架上。 本模组也会给已生成的服装和武器增加“放到目标服装架”命令。当殖民地有服装架时，点击命令再点击目标服装架，即可安排殖民者把该物品搬过去。目标服装架会自动允许该物品。取下物品时自动禁用对应物品类别的过滤器功能目前已暂停，因此取下衣物不会改变该类别的过滤器设置。

title: Common Mod Compatibility Patches
name: Common Mod Compatibility Patches
author: RunningBugs
description: A small collection of runtime compatibility patches for commonly used RimWorld mods. Every target-mod patch is dynamically detected at startup: if the corresponding mod/type/method is absent, the patch is skipped silently. Current patches: - RimWorld music: when recent-song filtering leaves only zero-commonality special-use songs, clear the recent-song filter so vanilla can choose a normal positive-weight song instead of returning null and spamming red errors. - Allow Tool: guard stale cached Haul Urgently things before RimWorld hauling APIs. - Build From Inventory / Replace Stuff: guard vanilla pathfinder reservation notifications for inventory-held or unspawned reservation targets. - Build From Inventory: clamp impossible HaulToContainer reservation stack counts after inventory drops. - Replace Stuff / TinyTweaks: guard Replace Stuff automatic bridge placement helper against null/invalid blueprint contexts. - Replace Stuff / TinyTweaks: guard Replace Stuff over-mineable blueprint helper against null/invalid blueprint contexts. - TinyTweaks: skip auto-rebuild blueprint placement when a launched building has no previous map context. - RimStory: guard broken saved individual-death anniversary events (ADead) with missing/invalid pawns and suppress exceptions from that event path. - RimStory: guard broken saved mass-funeral state when its last grave is missing, destroyed, unspawned, or belongs to another map; discard the stale funeral queue instead of repeating a NullReferenceException. - Vanilla Expanded Framework: serialize RimWorld goodwill-situation cache access and rebuild the cache if concurrent access has already corrupted it. - [NL] Dynamic Portraits: skip unsafe work-item overlays for job targets with incomplete ThingDef/graphic data and suppress residual DrawWorkItems UI exceptions. - NewRatkinPlus: replace wandering-caravan cleanup with a null-safe equivalent so stale saved settler-pool references do not call Dictionary.Remove(null) during the Ratkin wandering trader incident. - Anomaly Invoke Horax ritual: snapshot invoker inventory offerings before transferring them to the carry tracker and safely consume carried/inventory offerings at ritual end, avoiding collection-modified and unaccounted-offering errors. - Vanilla bed sleeping slots: replace the red "Could not find good sleeping slot position" error (bed reassigned or fully occupied while a pawn lies in it) with a graceful fallback that returns the pawn's actually occupied slot, logging a one-time warning instead. - Anomaly pawn duplicator (Unnatural Corpse incident): copy both gene lists before resolving override links and tolerate overriding genes missing on the duplicate (modded xenotypes), instead of crashing with "Sequence contains no matching element". - Pawn Health Bar: tighten the bleed-label boundary check so a pawn bleeding at exactly 0.01 rate no longer passes a null label to GenUI.GetWidthCached, avoiding an ArgumentNullException every frame; a one-time warning is logged instead. - Kiiro Race: skip the stealth hediff's glow check while the pawn has no map (caravan, shuttle, or other mapless state), so the hediff is no longer removed by vanilla after a NullReferenceException every tick. - Humanoid Alien Races: skip the RulesForPawn postfix when the pawn is null (e.g. Kiiro Story's wanderer-join quest letter with a missing generated pawn), so quest generation is no longer aborted by a NullReferenceException. - Minify Everything: restore the vanilla maxPawns-1 reservation check when issuing reinstall haul jobs, so jobs are no longer created for buildings still in use (e.g. an occupied bed), eliminating the repeated red "Could not reserve" errors; the job waits until the building is free again. - Vanilla LifeStageMinAge: when a life stage def is missing from a pawn's race (e.g. HumanlikeChild on alien races like Kiiro), return the same 0-age fallback vanilla produces after logging, but skip the red error; every caller (vanilla ideo certainty curve, 1trickPwnyta's Defaults birthday check, etc.) behaves exactly as unpatched, without the red spam. - QualityBuilder: guard the building/frame lookup against a null map captured from a despawned or carried frame, so the finish-frame job cleanup no longer throws a NullReferenceException. Target mods are listed under loadAfter, not as dependencies, so this mod can stay enabled even when some target mods are not installed.

title: Don't Meditate Yet 先别冥想
name: Don't Meditate Yet 先别冥想
author: RunningBugs
description: [h1]Don't Meditate Yet 先别冥想[/h1] In vanilla RimWorld, pawns will stop working but meditate when they are below the threshold, undrafted. However, this makes it very inconvenient when you just finished a fight outside your colony and wish to quickly pack up and leave, your pawns will just stop working and meditate. This mod will show a toggle gizmo button when the pawn has a psylink. By default, it's turned off, which aligns with the vanilla behavior, when it's turned on, pawns will not meditate. The status is remembered for each map, which means you can turn it off in your base map, and when you go to another map, you can turn it on. After getting back to the base map, it will automatically turn off. The default status when you start a new map could be configured in the mod settings. 在原版游戏里，小人会在精神力低于阈值时停止工作，去冥想恢复精神力。但是这会导致在战斗结束后，玩家希望快速收拾离开时，小人会停止工作去冥想，非常的不方便。 本mod会显示一个小人精神力低于阈值时的图标按钮，当按钮被激活时，小人不会去冥想，而是继续工作。默认情况下，按钮是关闭的，与原版游戏行为一致，当按钮被激活时，小人不会去冥想恢复精神力。这个状态会被记录在每个地图上，因此你可以将按钮在你的基地地图关闭，当你去到其他地图时，按钮可以被打开。当你回到基地地图时，按钮会自动调整为关闭状态。 默认情况下按钮的开关状态可以在模组选项中设置。

title: Linux IME Fix Linux 输入法修复
name: Linux IME Fix Linux 输入法修复
author: RunningBugs
description: [h1] Linux IME Fix Linux 输入法修复 [/h1] [h2] 中文说明 [/h2] 本 MOD 用于修复 Linux 下 RimWorld 文本框无法直接使用 IBus 输入法的问题。 [h2] 功能 [/h2] - 支持 Linux 版 RimWorld 1.6。 - 支持基于 IBus 的输入法，包括通过 IBus 使用的 Rime。 - 支持 RimWorld 的 IMGUI TextField/TextArea 文本框。 - 在游戏内显示预编辑/候选词窗口，支持光标跟随、UI 缩放、屏幕边缘处理和顶层绘制。 - 支持 Backspace 等组词编辑键。 [h2] 运行环境 [/h2] - Linux 版 RimWorld 1.6 - Harmony - 桌面会话中正在运行的 IBus - 对应语言的 IBus 输入引擎，例如 IBus Rime [h2] English [/h2] Fixes direct IBus input in RimWorld text fields on Linux. title: 流畅拖拽选择 Smooth Drag Select
name: 流畅拖拽选择 Smooth Drag Select
author: RunningBugs
description: 修复鼠标拖拽（如按住左键框选）时游戏卡顿的问题，支持高回报率鼠标。 原因：鼠标拖动时每秒产生大量 MouseDrag/MouseMove 事件，Unity 的 IMGUI 对每个事件都完整执行一遍界面树（殖民者栏、主按钮、窗口栈、各 MOD 窗口）。帧率越低，每帧积压的事件越多，形成恶性循环。挂在 OnGUI 上的 FPS 计数会因此显示虚高数值（如 900+），并非真实渲染帧率。 本 MOD 对这类事件做自适应限流：帧率正常时上限 60Hz，几乎无感；帧率下降时自动收紧至 10Hz 止损。画面更新仍由每帧的 Repaint 承担，功能无任何变化。 --- Fixes stuttering while dragging (e.g. left-button drag-select), especially with high polling-rate mice. Cause: a moving mouse generates many MouseDrag/MouseMove events per second, and Unity's IMGUI runs the entire UI tree (colonist bar, main buttons, window stack, mod windows) for every one of them. The lower the frame rate, the more events pile up per frame - a vicious cycle. OnGUI-based FPS counters report inflated numbers (e.g. 900+) which are not real rendered frames. The mod adaptively rate-limits these events: up to 60Hz when the frame rate is healthy (imperceptible), tightening to 10Hz when frames degrade. Visuals still refresh on the per-frame Repaint pass, so behavior is unchanged.

title: More Raid Strategies: Hybrid Raids 更多的袭击类型：复合袭击
name: More Raid Strategies: Hybrid Raids 更多的袭击类型：复合袭击
author: RunningBugs
description: The vanilla game has several raid types that we have been very familiar with, and in certain cases, we might want to try something different. This mod is trying to add a few raid types that are hybrid of the vanilla raid types. Warning: This could be hard, since we might have more frequent EdgeDrop raids, breaching raids, seige raids with breaching raids, etc. This mod is the first in my planned "More Raid Strategies" series, we might try to add more different raid types in the form of other mods in the future. Current implemented hybrid raids: - Siege and Breach: A siege group (0.5 x points) and a breaching group (0.7 x points) attack at the same time - Drop Pod and Breach: A drop-pod group (0.6 x points) and a breaching group (0.6 x points) attack at the same time The points mentioned here will also be ajusted so the actual points for a center-drop-pod group will be points * 0.6 * ajust-factor. 原版游戏的几种袭击类型，我们已经非常熟悉了，有时候，我们可能强的可怕，需要一些来自敌人的爱。 这个模组试图添加一些基于原版袭击类型的复合袭击类型。 警告：这可能会很难，因为我们可能会有更频繁的边缘掉落袭击、破门袭击，围攻配合破墙袭击等。 这个模组是我计划中的“更多袭击类型”系列中的第一个，在未来我们可能会在其他模组尝试添加更多不同的袭击类型。 当前实现的复合袭击类型： - 围攻配合破墙：一个围攻小队（0.5 x 点数）和一个破墙小队（0.7 x 点数）同时攻击 - 掉落配合破墙：一个掉落小队（0.6 x 点数）和一个破墙小队（0.6 x 点数）同时攻击 这里说的点数在袭击开始前会进行调整，所以一个中心空投小分队的实际点数是 预期点数 * 0.6 * 调整曲线。 It's possible not to use defs but to directly mix all in-game raid strategies (including modded ones) using C# code only. The reason we don't go this approach is we might want more control over how the raids are mixed. The downside is we have to manually configure each raid type we want to mix, unlike the pure C# code approach which can just generate all possible mixed types. 不使用XML Def，而是直接使用C#代码混合所有游戏内的袭击类型（包括模组添加的）是可行的。 我们不采用这种方法是为了更好地控制如何混合不同的袭击类型。 坏处是我们需要对每种想要复合的袭击类型进行手动配置。不像纯C#代码的方案可以直接生成所有可能的混合类型。

title: RimLocksmith 边缘锁匠
name: RimLocksmith 边缘锁匠
author: RunningBugs
description: RimLocksmith is a colony-door access control mod inspired by Locks2. It focuses on the common door access categories, explicit mod-door compatibility, built-in Chinese translation, default presets, multi-door batch editing, and white-box-tested core policy code. Current scope: RimLocksmith does not implement Locks2's advanced filters such as apparel, work type, race, bedroom owner, game condition, or detailed animal age/sex rules. Notable fixes and differences: - Default settings are configurable in the mod options. - New colony doors can automatically use the default rules. - Defaults can be applied to all unconfigured colony doors or forcibly applied to all colony doors. - Multiple selected colony doors can be edited together from the inspect tab; non-colony doors are ignored. - Fence-blocked pen animals keep vanilla behavior: even if colony animals are allowed by default, they cannot open normal colony doors by themselves. This avoids the Locks2-style problem where pen animals can escape because the mod overrides PawnCanOpen and bypasses vanilla roamerCanOpen / fence-blocking checks. Animal flaps and roamerCanOpen doors still follow vanilla semantics. 边缘锁匠是一个殖民地门禁配置 Mod。它参考 Locks2 的常用门禁分类，但使用独立架构，内置完整中文翻译，支持默认配置、多门批量修改、显式 Mod 门兼容，并通过白盒测试覆盖核心权限逻辑。 当前范围：本 Mod 不实现 Locks2 的高级过滤功能，例如按服装、工作类型、种族、卧室主人、游戏条件、动物年龄/性别等细分规则过滤。 主要差异和修复： - 模组选项中可以设置默认门禁规则。 - 新建殖民地门可以自动使用默认规则。 - 可以将默认规则应用到所有未设置过的殖民地门，或覆盖应用到所有殖民地门。 - 选择多扇殖民地门时，可以通过检查面板的标签页一起修改配置；非殖民地门会被忽略。 - 保留原版栅栏动物逻辑：即使默认允许殖民地动物，受栅栏限制的畜栏动物也不能自己打开普通殖民地门。这样避免了 Locks2 式问题：Mod 接管 PawnCanOpen 后绕过原版 roamerCanOpen / fence-blocking 检查，导致畜栏动物能打开普通门并跑出畜栏。动物门帘和 roamerCanOpen 门仍按原版语义处理。 Implemented using Hermes Agent w/ OpenAI-codex/GPT-5.5 使用Hermes Agent和OpenAI-codex/GPT-5.5实现代码
